title: Chapter 44 — The Kitchen and Bath Designer
intro: The channel's highest-leverage relationship — specification power and the partnership.

sections.title: Designers Specify the Product
sections.content:
Kitchen and bath designers have enormous influence. When they specify your brand and your store, the homeowner follows. When they specify a competitor, you never see the project.

The relationship with designers is about partnership — product knowledge support, showroom access, lead-time accuracy, and mutual respect. Designers are professionals. Treat them as peers, not customers.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating designer relationships, ask:

Is the salesperson building genuine partnerships with designers — or just taking orders?
Do designers trust their product knowledge and lead-time accuracy?
Are new designer relationships being developed — or is the salesperson relying on a few existing ones?
